## Says

- "Spiced tea, honey cakes, and a fortune on the house. It is always a nice one."
- "Forty years at this stall. I have poured for every Caller. Most of them spilled."
- "Your leaves say a journey. And a biscuit. Mostly the biscuit."
- "Tea-riffic to see you. I have a thousand of those. Brace yourself."
- "Leave your things with me. I keep them safe, and I keep them dry, which is more than the tea does."
